name: mods-image-preview
description: Shows thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt, in any terminal

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: auto: kitty graphics in kitty and Ghostty, an overlay where the terminal advertises one, colored quadrant blocks elsewhere. blocks, pixels and overlay force one renderer.

open.title: Open the original
open.description: ide: open each pasted image in the connected IDE's editor (JetBrains, VS Code) without taking the focus. viewer: the IDE when connected, the system image viewer otherwise. off: never on paste. Pressing a thumbnail's number opens it either way.
